2609.37673.title: KUPAS MASTER: Distilling the Tacit Expertise of Master Practitioners into Agent-Ready Experience Corpora
2609.37673.paper_summary: Experienced professionals know more than just facts and conclusions. They know which cues matter, why a judgment is reasonable, and which action to take. Routine work records often leave out this tacit knowledge, making it difficult for Large Language Model (LLM) agents to use professional experience effectively. We introduce KUPAS MASTER, an experience engineering platform built around nine-layer cognitive corpus construction. It turns heterogeneous work records and practitioner interviews into traceable, reusable experience corpora for agents. Six case elements preserve the task process: context, cues, judgment, action, boundaries, and outcomes. Nine-layer cognitive corpus construction organizes tacit experience along nine extraction dimensions and stores the resulting assets in six libraries: rules, constraints, best practices, negative examples, corner cases, and skills. Semantic alignment, individual experience distillation, organizational consolidation, and cross-review preserve source evidence, conditions of use, and unresolved disagreements. The platform packages these assets into callable skills with explicit inputs, steps, dependencies, and stopping conditions, connecting experience collection to task execution and evaluation feedback. Using authorized samples from 20 randomly selected practitioners, the platform processed 1,576 source files into 23,024 individual experience records and 13,113 organizational assets. The evaluation spans multiple professional domains. Under common task inputs and scoring criteria, the base model, raw corpus retrieval-augmented generation (RAG), and KUPAS MASTER agent scored 70.63, 79.75, and 89.58, respectively. The KUPAS MASTER agent improved on raw-corpus RAG in all seven scoring dimensions. The platform provides a practical path from individual tacit experience to organizational knowledge and agent capabilities.
2609.37673.paper_summary_zh: 經驗豐富的專業人士知道的不僅僅是事實和結論。<lb/>他們知道哪些線索重要，為什麼判斷是合理的，以及該採取什麼行動。<lb/>常規工作記錄往往忽略了這種默會知識，使得大型語言模型（LLM）代理有效利用專業經驗變得困難。<lb/>我們介紹了 KUPAS MASTER，一個圍繞九層認知語料庫構建的經驗工程平台。<lb/>它將異質的工作記錄和從業者訪談轉化為可追溯、可重用的經驗語料庫供代理使用。<lb/>六個案例元素保留了任務過程：上下文、線索、判斷、行動、邊界和結果。<lb/>九層認知語料庫構建沿著九個提取維度組織默會經驗，並將生成的資產存儲在六個庫中：規則、約束、最佳實踐、負面範例、邊緣案例和技能。<lb/>語義對齊、個體經驗提煉、組織整合和交叉審查保留了來源證據、使用條件和未解決的分歧。<lb/>該平台將這些資產打包成可調用的技能，並明確定義輸入、步驟、依賴關係和停止條件，將經驗收集與任務執行和評估反饋連接起來。<lb/>使用來自20位隨機選擇的從業者的授權樣本，該平台將1,576個源文件處理成23,024個個體經驗記錄和13,113個組織資產。<lb/>評估涵蓋多個專業領域。<lb/>在共同的任務輸入和評分標準下，基礎模型、原始語料檢索增強生成（RAG）和 KUPAS MASTER 代理的得分分別為70.63、79.75和89.58。<lb/>KUPAS MASTER 代理在所有七個評分維度上均優於原始語料 RAG。<lb/>該平台提供了一條從個體默會經驗到組織知識和代理能力的實用路徑。
